sections.title: Summary
sections.body: React Native Developer with 1+ years of experience developing web and cross-platform mobile applications using React, React Native, JavaScript, and Expo. Skilled in building reusable UI components, integrating REST APIs, working with MySQL, and debugging applications, with a strong focus on problem-solving and continuous technical growth.

entries.title: Junior Software Developer
entries.companyContext: Software solutions provider for ERP, web, and mobile applications.
entries.description:
[**Ordinal Campus — ERP Platform**](https://campus.ordinal.in/)

- Test ERP modules, troubleshoot application issues, and support ongoing product maintenance.
- Integrate REST APIs into the mobile application, including API testing, response handling, and dynamic data rendering.
- Implement new features and enhance existing mobile application functionality to improve usability and meet evolving business requirements.
- Handle technical support requests and verify application functionality across modules.

[**Findby — Web & Mobile Applications**](https://www.findby.in/)

- Develop and maintain web features using Next.js and mobile application features using React Native and Expo.
- Implement new features, fix bugs, and improve functionality across web and mobile platforms.
- Develop the Recent History feature and maintain business listing functionality on the web platform.
- Integrate APIs, handle dynamic data, and perform functional testing and debugging.
